subject: High School Schematic Design Recommendations
overview: Two advisory teams for the Medford High School project met to evaluate schematic design options, voting to recommend an updated site layout, an air-to-water heat pump HVAC system, and a power purchase agreement model for solar photovoltaics to the School Building Committee.

items.title: Parking Program and Updated Site Layout
items.summary: The advisory team voted unanimously to recommend the updated site plan featuring rotated athletic fields and distributed parking lots over the previous preliminary design.

items.title: Edgerly Track and Field Design
items.summary: Designers presented updates on the planned synthetic turf track and field at Edgerly Field, including lane layouts, bleachers, amenities, and ongoing coordination with the Department of Conservation and Recreation regarding deed-restricted land.

items.title: ECC Breezeway
items.summary: The design team presented a pedestrian breezeway concept cutting through the building to improve cross-site circulation and provide separate, dedicated entrances for the preschool and Curtis-Tufts programs.

items.title: Call for Assistance Stations
items.summary: Staff reviewed proposed locations for illuminated exterior call-for-assistance towers and co-located automated external defibrillator cabinets across parking areas and athletic fields.

items.title: HVAC System Recommendation
items.summary: The sustainability and MEP advisory team voted unanimously to recommend Option 3, a roof-mounted air-to-water heat pump system, to the School Building Committee.

items.title: Solar Photovoltaic System Options
items.summary: The team voted unanimously to recommend pursuing solar photovoltaics through a power purchase agreement to approach net-zero energy, with stipulations to confirm pool heating requirements, verify structural needs, and include solar renewable energy certificate purchases.
